task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, open the antique trunk in the bedroom. And then, recover the old key from the antique trunk. And then, look and see that the wooden door is unlocked with the old key. And then, open the wooden door within the bedroom. And then, try to head east. Following that, try to move south. After that, pick up the bell pepper from the couch in the living room. After that, attempt to take a trip north. Following that, sit the bell pepper on the stove. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
